scripts._comment:typecheck:test: Separate from `typecheck` because the root tsconfig only includes src/. test/e2e currently has 52 type errors (see tsconfig.test.json); this gate tracks them without turning the main gate red. Fold it back into `typecheck` once test/ is clean.
scripts.typecheck:examples: pnpm build && cd examples && pnpm install && pnpm typecheck
scripts.bench: pnpm build && cd benchmark && pnpm install && pnpm bench
scripts.bench:verify: pnpm build && cd benchmark && pnpm install && pnpm verify
